name: voice-agent-kit
title_zh: 从一句话需求到已上线电话代理的固定流水线
tagline_zh: 客户说要个新电话代理？不用从空白画布开始。你给需求，它跑完建流程、改话术、设声音、测通话、提取事后任务。
tagline_en: Need a new phone agent? Skip the blank canvas. Give it the brief; it handles building, tweaking, testing, and.
desc_en: Build, change and ship ElevenLabs voice agents. Use this skill for anything voice-agent related — a new phone agent for a customer, changing an existing agent's behavior, opener or voice, a test call, or post-call task extraction. Runs a fixed pipeline from briefing to deployed agent.
why_zh: 把从需求到上线的隐性步骤固化成可复跑流程，每次改动都走同一条验证路径，不会漏掉测试通话或事后任务提取。
why_en: Turns the messy brief-to-deploy journey into a repeatable pipeline, so every change gets the same test-call and post-call.
limit_zh: 只认 ElevenLabs 代理；不接其他语音平台。依赖你提供 ElevenLabs API 密钥和电话供应商凭证。
limit_en: ElevenLabs agents only. Needs your API key and telephony provider credentials. Delivers a configured agent, not number provisioning or carrier.
title_en: Fixed pipeline from briefing to deployed phone agent
